test_cases.name: Example 1: Simple Sequence (Alice→Bob)
Example 2: Classes with Relations
Example 3: Auth System (Auth Architecture - 8 classes, 50+ methods)
test_cases.input:
@startuml
class userRepository {
  - dbConnection: Connection
  - cache: CacheStore
  + findById(id: number): User
  + findByEmail(email: string): User
  + create(user: User): User
  + update(user: User): User
  + delete(id: number): void
  - getCacheKey(id: number): string
}

class authService {
  - userRepo: userRepository
  - tokenManager: tokenManager
  - passwordHasher: passwordHasher
  + login(email: string, password: string): AuthToken
  + register(user: UserData): User
  + validateToken(token: string): User
  + refreshToken(token: string): AuthToken
  - hashPassword(password: string): string
  - verifyPassword(plain: string, hash: string): boolean
}

class tokenManager {
  - secret: string
  - expirationTime: number
  + generateToken(payload: object): string
  + validateToken(token: string): object
  + decodeToken(token: string): object
  + revokeToken(token: string): void
}

class passwordHasher {
  - saltRounds: number
  + hash(password: string): string
  + verify(password: string, hash: string): boolean
  + validateStrength(password: string): boolean
}

class apiController {
  - authService: authService
  + loginHandler(req: Request, res: Response): void
  + registerHandler(req: Request, res: Response): void
  + logoutHandler(req: Request, res: Response): void
  + getProfileHandler(req: Request, res: Response): void
}

class errorHandler {
  - logger: logger
  + handle(error: Error): ErrorResponse
  + logError(error: Error): void
  + sendResponse(error: Error, res: Response): void
}

class logger {
  - logLevel: string
  + debug(message: string): void
  + info(message: string): void
  + warn(message: string): void
  + error(message: string, error?: Error): void
}

userRepository --> authService
authService --> userRepository
authService --> tokenManager
authService --> passwordHasher
apiController --> authService
apiController --> errorHandler
errorHandler --> logger

@enduml

test_cases.name: Example 4: Social Media Platform (9 classes, 55+ methods)
test_cases.input:
@startuml
class userProfile {
  - userId: string
  - username: string
  - followers: Set<string>
  - following: Set<string>
  + getProfile(userId: string): Profile
  + updateBio(bio: string): void
  + follow(targetUserId: string): void
  + unfollow(targetUserId: string): void
  + getFollowerCount(): number
}

class postRepository {
  - posts: Map<string, Post>
  - index: Index
  + createPost(content: string, author: string): PostId
  + deletePost(postId: string): void
  + getPost(postId: string): Post
  + getTimelinePosts(userId: string, limit: number): Post[]
  + searchPosts(keyword: string): Post[]
}

class likeService {
  - postRepository: postRepository
  + likePost(postId: string, userId: string): void
  + unlikePost(postId: string, userId: string): void
  + getLikeCount(postId: string): number
  + isLiked(postId: string, userId: string): boolean
}

class commentService {
  - postRepository: postRepository
  + addComment(postId: string, userId: string, text: string): CommentId
  + deleteComment(commentId: string): void
  + getComments(postId: string): Comment[]
  + replyToComment(commentId: string, userId: string, text: string): void
}

class feedGenerator {
  - userProfile: userProfile
  - postRepository: postRepository
  + generateFeed(userId: string): Post[]
  + getRecommendations(userId: string): Post[]
  + getSuggestedUsers(userId: string): User[]
}

class notificationHub {
  - webSocketServer: webSocketServer
  + notifyLike(postId: string, userId: string): void
  + notifyComment(postId: string, userId: string): void
  + notifyFollow(targetUserId: string, userId: string): void
  + notifyMention(targetUserId: string, postId: string): void
}

class webSocketServer {
  - connections: Map<string, Connection>
  + broadcast(message: Message): void
  + sendToUser(userId: string, message: Message): void
  + registerConnection(userId: string): void
}

class mediaStorage {
  - cloudProvider: cloudProvider
  + uploadImage(file: bytes): ImageUrl
  + uploadVideo(file: bytes): VideoUrl
  + deleteMedia(mediaId: string): void
}

class cloudProvider {
  - apiKey: string
  + store(key: string, data: bytes): void
  + retrieve(key: string): bytes
  + delete(key: string): void
}

userProfile --> feedGenerator
postRepository --> feedGenerator
likeService --> postRepository
commentService --> postRepository
notificationHub --> webSocketServer
notificationHub --> userProfile
mediaStorage --> cloudProvider

@enduml
